pluginText.pf.questions: {"beforeTimes":["new to flying, a student pilot, or a licensed pilot (sets the service: a discovery flight, the next lesson, a solo, a flight review or checkout)","what the lesson is for, and the next stage of training if the student knows it","which aircraft type, if the pilot is checked out in one","for a discovery flight: how many people fly, and whether a guest under 18 is coming","for a flight in the customer's own aircraft (flow B): the airport and the aircraft type"],"afterTime":["anything the instructor should know (last lesson's topic, nerves)","for a solo: the practice area or route the instructor agreed"],"securePage":["each person's weight for the flight, for the aircraft's weight limits (never in a text, never through the AI)","the student's date of birth (age limits for solo and for certificates)","proof of citizenship, or the date of the school's federal security approval for a student who isn't a citizen, where the federal rules require it before training","the student pilot certificate and medical certificate: kind and end date (for a solo)","for the customer's own aircraft: the owner's name, the yearly inspection date, and the insurance showing the instructor may fly it","the waiver and the school's training agreement"],"whoMayBook":"an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs their OK; a teen who starts a booking forwards the link to a parent"}
pluginText.pf.safety: {"stop":[{"words":"an aircraft crash or fire happening now, someone hurt at the airport, an aircraft overdue or missing","say":"Call 911 now. missing or ended: a dual lesson instead, or no solo"},{"name":"Instructor's solo endorsement","when":"before each supervised solo","who":"the student's own instructor gives it","goodFor":"the time the federal rules set (90 days), or as the instructor limits it","result":"in date: the solo books; ended: a dual flight first"},{"name":"The owner's aircraft papers (flow B)","when":"on the secure page before a flight in the customer's own aircraft","who":"the aircraft's owner","result":"the yearly inspection in date and insurance that lets the instructor fly it: it goes ahead; missing: the instructor gives ground only, or it moves"}],"prep":"bring the logbook, a photo ID, the headset if you have one, and the student pilot and medical certificates for a solo; eat first; check in 15 minutes early"}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"checkIn":"at the front desk: the check-in code and the photo ID; for a solo, the student pilot and medical certificates are shown; the class roster for ground school; at the customer's own airport (flow B): the code at the hangar","beforeWork":"the instructor checks the student is fit to fly, checks the weather against the limits, and does the preflight check of the aircraft with the student; no flight if any check fails","changes":"weather or an aircraft defect turns the flight into a ground or simulator lesson, or moves it with no fee; a flight that goes longer than the block is billed at the same rates from the meter, and more than 30 minutes over needs the student's yes first","done":"the aircraft's meter reading in and out, the instructor's hours, and DONE; the instructor signs the student's logbook and fills the training record","record":"the training record and logbook entry (date, aircraft, hours, what was taught, any endorsement), kept as the federal rules require","children":"a parent stays at the airport for a discovery flight or lesson under 16; a student pilot of 16 or 17 may come alone with the parent's signed OK on file and is handed back only to an adult on the pick-up list if one is named"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"a discovery flight and the ground school course are paid in full or with a deposit when booking; lessons and solos save a card for the fee; the course's rest is paid at the first evening, never charged later on its own","after":"a lesson block is charged at DONE on the saved card, or a ground lesson paid at the front desk; the course's rest at the first evening; a flight-training series' rest on the bill after the last visit","caps":"deposit cap: from the state form; prepaid training money kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it","cancel":"free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting); a weather or aircraft cancel by the school is always free","fees":"a late cancel or no-show: $75 (example), only with the owner's OK, and never more than what was paid now; never for weather, an aircraft defect, or a student who says before the flight that they aren't fit to fly. A student who arrives impaired (drinking in the last 8 hours, or drugs) doesn't fly, and it's treated like a late cancel: any fee is the owner's call.","refunds":"a lesson the school cancels is never charged; unused ground school evenings are refunded under the course terms; an unused block of hours is refunded under its terms","tax":"where the state's rules tax aircraft time or instruction","tips":"none","fee2":"Rosfield's $2 applies: one $2 per confirmed booking; a series of transition visits counts once","goods":"headsets, logbooks, charts and pilot supplies are the school's own sale at the front desk, outside Rosie"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never":"weight, date of birth, medical certificate details, health answers, citizenship papers and certificate numbers never go in a text: only the secure page","staffTexts":"texts to instructors name the student and the lesson only; the weight and certificate details open on the secure page","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"each instructor's federal flight instructor certificate and ratings are the school's own word, shown to the owner; not checked by Rosie (D96)","skills":"discovery flights, primary training, instrument, multi-engine, tailwheel, checkout flights, flight reviews, simulator, ground school, stage checks (the chief instructor or a second instructor)","supervision":"a supervised solo needs an instructor on duty at the school for the whole flight; the student's own instructor gives the endorsement","oks":"the student's instructor OKs each solo and its weather limits; the chief instructor OKs stage checks and checkride sign-offs; the owner OKs fees, refunds and new renters","standIn":"another instructor with the same ratings may take a lesson, offered to the student first, never assumed; a stage check must be with a different instructor","dutyLimits":"an instructor gives no more than 8 hours of flight training in 24 hours (the federal rule as a switch)","away":"only instructors cleared by the owner fly customers' own aircraft (flow B)","certificates":"each instructor's certificate end date, if the school enters one: a reminder for the owner only"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"aircraft":"aircraft used for hire or instruction have the inspections the federal rules require; an aircraft past one isn't offered","training":"training records and logbook endorsements as the federal rules require; the school's own syllabus decides the next lesson","solo":"a solo needs the student pilot certificate, a medical (or the federal rule's alternative), the instructor's endorsement in date, and an instructor on duty; the business's own word on each one","security":"a student who isn't a citizen: the school's own federal approval step, before flight training starts; the school keeps the proof itself; Rosie never checks a document (D96)","alcohol":"no flying within 8 hours of drinking or while impaired (the federal rule, and the school's own rule)","school":"where the state's rules license flight schools as private or vocational schools: the enrollment contract, its cancel window and any bond for prepaid training (a switch)","records":"training records, waivers and agreements kept as long as the federal rules ask, and at least 7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"weather":"weather below the limits: the instructor decides before the flight; a ground or simulator lesson at the same time, or a move with no fee","aircraft":"an aircraft down for a defect or an inspection: another aircraft of the same type, a simulator or ground lesson, or a move with no fee","notFit":"a student who isn't fit to fly: no flight; a ground lesson, or a move","checkride":"the checkride date is set by the examiner and can't move: the school keeps the aircraft and offers another of the same type if one goes down","late":"a late student: the lesson is shorter inside the block, or becomes ground only","overrun":"the flight runs past the block: billed from the meter; more than 30 minutes over needs the student's yes","minor":"a student under 18: a parent books and signs; a solo at 16 and up only","noShow":"a no-show: the fee only with the owner's OK","standIn":"the student's instructor out: another instructor with the ratings, offered first, or a move","emergency":"an incident in flight is handled by the instructor and the federal reporting rules; Rosie tells the owner at once and says nothing to anyone else","other":"all other edge cases the generic way"}
